data_issues: Train and val are not independent trials: the 760 labeled trials are near-duplicate copies (small spike-count jitter, Euclidean NN distance ~3-4 vs ~12-18 between genuinely distinct trials such as test) of only 320 unique source trials (200 duplicated twice, 120 three times), and the duplicates are shared across the train/val split. Thus val is leaked from train: naive val accuracy is ~100% and naive CV ~90%, both badly inflated; grouped CV over unique source trials gives ~0.68. Test trials are not duplicates of anything. Labels themselves are consistent with orientation_deg; val class counts are also unbalanced (8-20 per class).
